title: Recordings with declared inputs: a VariableSet as the scope of named variables, and esym.Function of expressions and a set of inputs
author: Claude-JG
description: Decided: R2 of docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md section 12.6. A recording is bound to the signature of an item user function today; the composed system borrows the signature of ObjectGenericODE2 and cannot add y, lambda or parameters. A VariableSet becomes the scope of named variables - scalars, vectors and matrices, a name unique in its set -, a recording declares its inputs as a set, esym.Function(expressions, inputs), evaluated, differentiated and exported as a UserFunction; CreateSymbolicUserFunction builds the set of the item signature. Needed by the parameters as variables and the system variables (section 12.7).
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolic.Function(result, inputs, name) records an expression in declared inputs - a list of named variables or a VariableSet - as a UserFunction without item and mbs; VariableSet holds named Reals, Vectors and Matrices in the order they were added and is the scope of their names; SymbolicSystem composes its system by it.
